publicPath.description: Public URL base path for all chunk assets: the entry module, its stylesheets, the own chunks and each shared[].chunkPath resolve against it (e.g. 'http://localhost:3001/' or '/'). A relative value resolves against the host document's base URL. Fetch-list document and list-item locations also resolve against it when metaData.sharedBase is absent.

sharedBase.description: Optional shared-file base location for resolving fetch-list document and list-item locations, separate from the asset base location (publicPath). When present, those locations resolve against this value by the same rules as shared[].chunkPath resolves against publicPath; when absent, they resolve against publicPath. See cpt-frontx-adr-shared-dep-reuse.

version.description: Concrete version resolved from node_modules (e.g. '19.2.4'). Contains neither ':' nor '@'. Identifies the package input only; it does not imply identical source text across MFEs.

chunkPath.description: The standalone ESM file for this dependency: an http(s) URL, or a path relative to metaData.publicPath that stays under it (e.g. 'shared/react.js'). The location rules, including the values that fail the load, are defined by cpt-frontx-adr-mfe-asset-discovery and the mfe-loading FEATURE (cpt-frontx-algo-mfe-loading-manifest-discovery, inst-md-resolve-chunk-path).

contentHash.description: Optional sha256 hex digest (64 lowercase hex characters) of this entry's file, declared by the producing build. It is the key under which the entry's text is shared across loads. See cpt-frontx-adr-mfe-asset-discovery.

entryLists.description: Optional fetch-list document per exposed module, keyed by the exposed module name (e.g. './lifecycle'), matching the exposedModule of the MFE entry that references this manifest. When the entry being loaded carries a list, its shared dependencies are loaded through the list. See cpt-frontx-adr-shared-dep-reuse.

location.description: Location of the fetch-list document: a path relative to the shared base location, or an absolute http(s) URL.

contentHash.description: sha256 hex digest (64 lowercase hex characters) of the fetch-list document, declared by the producing build. It is the key under which the document's text is shared.
